_comment: Copy to config.json (or set another path with ARTEX_CONFIG). This file contains only database and skill_dir; configure LLM and other settings through environment variables or the application.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: ARTEX_PG_DSN environment variable > database in this file. Choose either (A) the fields below or (B) one complete database.dsn connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Option (B): remove the database object above and use a complete DSN. Non-empty dsn takes precedence over separate fields.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory containing SKILL.md). Priority: ARTEX_SKILL_DIR environment variable > this field > default (skills/ beside the executable). Leave empty or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved from the current working directory.
